clips.title: The story
paras: Syurna sends you to learn what Sethir the Ancient knows of Teldrassil's corruption. The satyr waits near the Oracle Glade, beyond the reach of those who tried force or diplomacy.

Teldrassil's growing sickness troubles the night elf leaders in Darnassus. Syurna, the rogue trainer, needs someone subtle; armed patrols have died trying to reach Sethir the Ancient. The satyr roosts on a remote bough near the Oracle Glade and has turned away force and diplomacy alike. To learn what he knows, you need to enter his lair and take his personal possessions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We believe there is one being that may be able to help us understand what is happening to the forests of Teldrassil. Unfortunately, getting the creature to cooperate has proven disastrous.
He hides on a branch at the outskirts of the Oracle Glade. All who have so far approached the satyr, whether through force or diplomacy, have met with doom. Perhaps stealth is the answer, friend.
Find what Sethir the Ancient carries in his packs and report back to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you anything to report from Sethir the Ancient, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is grim news, friend. It would seem that the sickness which has gripped the forests and rivers of Darkshore has begun to taint our home.
You have served us well, but there is nothing more you can do here. Take this blade as a reward for your service to Teldrassil.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
